tex_content.html:
Corollary
[harmonic curvature and Codazzi Ricci tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0365 ↗ prop:pet-ch9-harmonic-iff-codazzi-constant-trace ↗ rem:pet-ch9-ricci-codazzi-identity ↗ thm:pet-ch9-curvature-tensor-lichnerowicz 1. ch9:9.4.5The following conditions are equivalent: $\operatorname {Ric}$ is harmonic, $\operatorname {Ric}$ is Codazzi with constant trace, and $ abla ^*R=0$ (equivalently, $R$ is harmonic).
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch9-ricci-harmonic-iff-curvature-harmonic \sketch The identity in subsection 4.3 equates $d^ abla \operatorname {Ric}$ with the divergence of $R$, while the contracted Bianchi identity makes $ abla ^*\operatorname {Ric}$ a constant multiple of $d\operatorname {scal}$. Thus $\operatorname {Ric}$ is harmonic exactly when $R$ is divergence free. The constant-trace characterization in subsection 4.3 yields the equivalent formulations.

□
